verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only creating a new verification session for each flow ('Every verification flow begins with creating a session'), plus decisions, webhooks and SDKs. Nothing documents recognizing a previously verified person or reusing a prior passed check instead of running a full verification again. Ongoing watchlist monitoring is a different capability and does not count as reuse of a verification.

support.subject: As a developer, a person verified once can be recognized and reused across sessions or products — documented re-verification and reuse of a prior passed check instead of forcing a full re-run
